headline: Mexican Stock Exchange Halts Rally as Optimism on Wall Street Moderates
summary: Mexico's local indexes, which gained more than 1% in the morning, were roughly unchanged as risk appetite moderated. The fading optimism followed a softer tone on Wall Street.
why: The S&P/BMV IPC is Mexico's main equity benchmark, and it tends to track shifts in global risk sentiment and US markets.
original_headline: Bolsa mexicana detiene el repunte ante moderación del optimismo en Wall Street
